title: More beautiful than the pictures
text: More beautiful than the pictures. I am absolutely in love with these towels. I’ve had them in my cart for 5 months. The pictures do NOT do justice, they’re absolutely beautiful!

product_metadata.title: KAF Home Pantry Rooster Kitchen Dish Towel Set of 4, 100-Percent Cotton, 18 x 28-inch
features: Set of 4 includes: 1 Rooster print towel and 3 Yarn Dye towels as shown in image
Each towel is 18 x 28-Inch in size unwashed and then Minimal Shrinkage may occur after washing / drying
Each towel comes with a convenient sewn in loop for easy hanging
Roosters are year round, this Kitchen Dish Towel Set of 4 is ideal for your own kitchen or makes a lovely housewarming gift
100-Percent Cotton, Made in India. Wash in Cold Water with like colors, Dry in warm dryer
